sourceRefs: Codex and Codex2 shared-account review independence
current shared checkout patch is byte-for-byte PR #4401 diff

acceptance: This is a governed source-of-truth repair for the already-authored PR #4401 policy patch. Do not design a different policy and do not modify supervisor code, config, runtime state, product code, or the 28-task catalog.

Start from current origin/dev in a clean governed task worktree and materialize exactly the AGENTS.md +74 patch currently carried by PR #4401. The patch classifies direct repair versus integration/coordination, makes the Pantheon supervisor the sole routine implementation dispatcher, prohibits chatbox parallel implementation fleets, and records that Codex/Codex2 currently share one ChatGPT account and are not independent capacity or review identities.
Do not treat the dirty shared checkout as a delivery branch. Compare its AGENTS.md delta and PR #4401 patch byte-for-byte, then deliver from the clean task worktree.

If PR #4401 can be safely refreshed to current dev without altering the policy patch, use a non-force current-dev merge and bind the final exact head. Otherwise create the exact V3 task branch and PR; never merge two duplicate policy PRs.
After a valid replacement/current PR exists, close or supersede stale evidence PR #4405 and leave a traceable link. Do not delete branches or history.

Add or run deterministic assertions for every required clause, including the exact Codex/Codex2 shared-account paragraph, no direct patching of pantheon-ci-deploy/dev-root, supervisor-only dispatch, governed packet requirement, and read-only-only chatbox subagent boundary.
Verify the diff contains only AGENTS.md plus V3 task brief/review evidence if needed; no .orchestrator/config.json, canonical state, runtime, queue, product, or deployment changes.
Run git diff --check, policy text assertions, commit-trailer validation, and all exact-head GitHub checks.
Evidence must identify PR #4401 head, final delivery head, current origin/dev, exact file hashes, stale #4405 disposition, and remain review_pending until Human/Ops exact-head approval.
Deliver commit(s), correctly titled PR to dev, all checks, independent Human/Ops exact-head approval, governed merge, and canonical done/archive. Rollback is revert of the policy merge commit.
